result.title: Zero-Shot Weight-Space Programming for Prediction and Classification of Target Variables in Structured Datasets
result.summary: Weight-space programming fixes every parameter of a feed-forward network by hand, with no gradient descent anywhere in the construction. Every demonstration so far starts from a target function handed to the model as a rule system, making it a compilation problem. A supervised dataset withholds that specification, so the procedure must do the statistical inference itself and then express the result in the parameterisation it was given. We ask whether a large language model can do both. It is shown a small dataset in full, with the architecture of a feed-forward network, and writes out every weight and bias as a literal number, with no optimizer, no gradient, no code execution, and no chance to evaluate it first. Each construction is sealed and pre-registers its expected score. The graded suite runs from two toy problems, through nine synthetic problems disguised by a hidden rotation, to the classical benchmarks and one real engineering regression. The frozen network matches the closed-form optimum wherever that optimum is linear, reaches the irreducible error of the generating process on three rungs where it is not, and beats every fitted baseline on two of those, including the same architecture trained by gradient descent. It fails on two rungs, both times because the structure to be found is oblique to the coordinates it analysed. Three further constructors separate two failure modes a single score conflates: one returns no parameter vector at all on the hardest rungs, another delivers everywhere while writing networks worse than predicting the mean. One of those failures proves avoidable: another constructor solves the oblique-hinge rung by a margin that survives multiple-comparison correction. What predicts whether the hidden layer earns its keep is the training error of a linear separator, which the composite complexity index misses.

AI.brief_summary: 论文检验 LLM 能否只给定小型监督数据集，就逐数字写出前馈网络的权重与偏置，全程无梯度、无代码执行；并在由玩具题、隐藏旋转的合成题到经典基准和真实工程回归组成的分级套件上，以预先密封的预期分数评估结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 「数据集到参数」的编译式设定与「隐藏层是否值得」的预测指标，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 计算是否真正被使用；其区分的「不输出参数」与「输出但劣于预测均值」两种失败，也与视觉证据是否落入答案、何时弃答的问题相邻。
